notes.title: Patch 1.2.67
notes.content:
Patch 1.2.67:

 Extended Radiostation Level with an additional mini-game
 Greatly expanded the Tunnel Level
 Multiple new puzzles
 Improved AI
 Steam Achievements are now available
 Various Menu improvements
 Added the ability to adjust Settings in game
 Improved Inventory
 Improved Flashlight
 Improved game objectives system
 Multiple bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Sign Language Update
notes.content: In this update, we're adding Sign Language support for English and Polish languages as an experimental feature. We would like to encourage our players to give us feedback on the quality of this new feature.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.08
notes.content:
Added localization in 9 languages (French, German, Italian, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, Ukrainian, Russian, Uzbek)
 Introduced subtitles
 Added a quest system to display current objectives
 Multiple bugfixes and improvements under the hood

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2.
